description: A user's report that headings vanish from a multi-line prompt, with no failing test; reproduce it, find the defect and fix it
prompt:
A user sent this in:

> My system prompt is Markdown, written over several lines with continuation backslashes. The model never sees my headings. This is the program:
>
> ```
> system You answer support mail for a bike shop. \
> # Rules \
> Never promise a refund. \
> # Tone \
> Be brief.
> run A customer asks whether they can return a helmet.
> ```
>
> `nb --compile` on it shows a system prompt with no `# Rules` and no `# Tone` line in it. I'm sure this used to work.

nb's tests all pass. Can you find what's wrong and fix it? Don't change the existing tests; add one if it helps.
